title: Customs officers have police powers
question: What does Nigeria Customs Service Act 2023 section 6 say about customs officers have police powers?

**Section 6 of the Nigeria Customs Service Act 2023** provides:

Customs officers exercise police powers for customs purposes: arrest, search, seize, detain, prosecute
